title: Explore Acely for Free - No Credit Card Required
summary: Take a free SAT or ACT practice test and skills assessment on Acely with no credit card required. Unlock all of Acely with a 3-day free trial.
body_markdown:
Exciting news! Acely now has an entirely free version that gives students access to a short skills assessment and free SAT and ACT practice tests, no credit card required.


Take a free SAT or ACT practice test and see what Acely can do for your score.


[Try Acely for free - no credit card!](https://acely.com/sign-up)


## Why free practice tests matter more than ever


The SAT and ACT have shifted to predominantly digital exams in recent years, but the number of high-quality, free tests available for students to use to prepare has remained limited. The College Board offers seven full-length digital practice exams and the ACT has four.


Through our first-party research, we've found that students have the best outcomes when they take at least eight practice tests. This means that if a student is actively studying for 3+ months, it's easy to burn through the available tests and still not feel fully prepared to achieve their best outcome.


Additionally, if a student retests, they may not have enough new tests to study for their new test date. The College Board and ACT both recommend students take their tests at least twice to have a higher superscore, yet students may not have enough material to study for multiple dates.


Acely was built to make test preparation more accessible and offer more personalized resources for modern-era standardized tests. That's why students can now access some of the best Acely features, including practice tests, entirely for free, without providing a credit card up front.


## What's included in the free version


With Acely's free version, students can:


- Take a short skills assessment to see which areas to focus on for the SAT or ACT
- Complete one free[SAT](https://acely.com/sat-prep) practice test
- Complete one free[ACT](https://acely.com/act-prep) practice test


No credit card is required to get started.


If a student wants to view pacing insights or practice similar questions to the ones they missed on their practice test, all they need to do is start a free trial to unlock full Acely features.


## Unlock the full Acely experience with a 3-day free trial


Once students start their 3-day free trial, they'll unlock all of Acely's features, including a daily study plan that targets their areas for improvement. Their study plan continuously updates to reflect what they need to focus on to improve their score.


In addition to their study plan, they'll get access to a full question bank with more than 15,000 SAT and ACT educator-crafted questions. As they're studying, they can get detailed explanations and hints with Acely's AI tutor that is available 24/7.


### Ready to try Acely?


Start free with no credit card, or unlock everything with a 3-day free trial.


[Try Acely for free - no credit card!](https://acely.com/sign-up)


## Who this is for


If you're a student who has been actively studying and you're looking for more free SAT or ACT practice tests,[try one for free here](https://acely.com/sign-up) . And if you're just getting started with test prep, take the free skills assessment to see which areas you should focus on for the SAT or ACT.
